subject: Acme Maps — Mutual Action Plan (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@acmemaps.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Maps — Mutual Action Plan (post-call recap)

Thanks for taking the time today, Alex — great conversation. Below is a short recap of what we heard and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep next steps clear. Please flag anything I missed or want to change.

Quick recap of pain & goals
- Pain: High inference cost and unpredictable latency on peak map tile generation; frequent throttling during large batch exports.
- Goals: Move to a predictable, lower-cost inference platform with sub-200ms 95th pct latency for interactive map annotations and a predictable monthly spend for budgeting.
- Constraints: Must comply with data residency for EU tiles (phase 2) and provide audit logs for requests.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level)
1) Technical validation — Redwood PoC
   - Owner: Connor O'Brien (SE) + Acme devs (Priya)
   - Deliverable: PoC on a representative subset (real tile workload), perf numbers (p50/p95), and cost estimate
   - Target date: 2027-01-26

2) Security & compliance review
   - Owner: Neha Kapoor (Security) + Acme security (Tom)
   - Deliverable: SOC 2 scope, data retention policy, network topology for Private deployment
   - Target date: 2027-02-09

3) Procurement & pricing approval
   - Owner: Alex Thompson + Redwood AE (Marissa)
   - Deliverable: Commercial terms, SOW/commit, and PO issuance
   - Target date: 2027-02-23

4) Pilot / phased rollout
   - Owner: Acme platform + Redwood Dedicated team
   - Deliverable: Live pilot (subset of traffic), telemetry dashboard, cost baseline
   - Target date: 2027-03-15

Action items from our call
- Connor: prepare PoC plan and test harness by EOD Friday (2027-01-15).
- Marissa: send MAP spreadsheet and baseline pricing (attached).
- Alex: confirm internal stakeholders (security/procurement) and desired PO timeline.

Attachments: Acme_MAPs_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), redwood-pricing.pdf

Proposed next meeting: 30 min technical walkthrough + PoC scoping — Thu 2027-01-20 10:00am PT. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@acmemaps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.ra@acmemaps.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acmemaps.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 17:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Maps — Mutual Action Plan (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A few quick confirmations and one ask: 

Confirmations
- Pain/goals: yes, that aligns with what we discussed. Sub-200ms p95 is the right target for interactive workflows.
- Timeline: PoC in the next two weeks works.

Stakeholders to add
- Priya Rao (Director, GIS) — will lead scope for sample datasets and validation criteria.
- Tom Lee (VP Engineering) — will be involved on security and procurement approvals.

Ask
- Can you include our procurement timeline constraints? We need to submit budget requests by 2027-02-10, so commercial terms would ideally be agreed before then.
- Tom wants to see SOC 2 and evidence of audit logs. Would Neha be our security contact to coordinate?

Also noted the attached MAP — I'll review with Priya and Tom and get back with any edits. Tentatively OK for Thu 2027-01-20 10am PT for the technical walkthrough.

Thanks Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. Per your ask, updated MAP below with procurement constraint and security owner. I've also attached an updated MAP spreadsheet with explicit acceptance criteria.

Updated Mutual Action Plan (finalized for exec review)
1) Technical validation — Redwood PoC
   - Owner: Connor O'Brien (SE) + Priya Rao (Acme)
   - Deliverable: PoC run on representative tile workload; perf report (p50/p95), memory/cost metrics
   - Target date: 2027-01-26

2) Security & compliance review
   - Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood Security) + Tom Lee (Acme)
   - Deliverable: SOC 2 report, data retention policy, network architecture + audit log access plan
   - Target date: 2027-02-02

3) Procurement & pricing approval (aligned to Acme budget cycle)
   - Owner: Alex Thompson + Marissa Cole
   - Deliverable: Commercial terms and SOW to meet Acme budget request by 2027-02-10
   - Target date: 2027-02-08 (buffer for internal approvals)

4) Pilot / phased rollout
   - Owner: Acme platform + Redwood Dedicated operations
   - Deliverable: Pilot deployment, observability dashboard, cost baseline and go/no-go criteria
   - Target date: 2027-03-15

Next steps
- Connor: PoC plan + harness (EOD 2027-01-15) — Connor, please include test dataset size and expected token counts.
- Alex: confirm final stakeholder list and procurement PO window (by 2027-01-18).
- Marissa: I'll schedule the technical walkthrough for Thu 2027-01-20 10:00am PT and send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Acme_MAPs_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), redwood-pricing.pdf
Related links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 | MAP doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4D5E

Best,
